context: Daichi and Ryosuke share an evening drink.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 亮介さん、一緒に、お酒、嬉しい。
lines.en: Ryosuke-san, being able to drink together like this—it makes me so happy.
lines.style: Warm, effusive opening with Kansai lilt. Genuine gratitude in the voice, not performed. Soft attack on his name, then the warmth floods in. Real affection threaded throughout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Yeah. Family—it really is good, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, almost thinking out loud. Gentle, steady warmth. No performance, just recognition. Soft landing on each phrase, like he's feeling the truth of it as he speaks.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm grateful for this. Truly, always.
lines.style: Sincere and emphatic, Kansai warmth curving through the words. Deeper note of feeling underneath—not just appreciation but reverence for what this moment holds. Steady, full-voiced.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Fun like this—every single day. That's what it is.
lines.style: Philosophical undertone. Warm but reflective, as if he's gently settling into the meaning of his own words. Soft, unhurried pace. The tenderness of recognizing something precious.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Slow, deliberate warmth. The regional Kansai swing gentle in the delivery. A closing note—reverent, almost vulnerable. Soft trailing-off, like he's speaking something he deeply feels.
